people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
translations.bsb: When the whole congregation saw that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.
translations.kjv: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
